description: Latest surveillance data for one FOPH topic and region: reported cases (or GP consultations / detections / wastewater load) per week, month or year, with incidence per 100'000 and trend where published. region: 'CHFL' (Switzerland + Liechtenstein, default for mandatory reporting), 'CH', a canton code ('ZH'), or a wastewater plant (e.g. 'basel'). breakdown: 'agegroup', 'sex', 'pathogen' or 'subtype' (variants) to split the totals. Recent periods are provisional. Example: {topic: 'influenza', region: 'ZH', last_periods: 8}.

from.description: Return all periods from this one on instead, e.g. '2025-W40', '2024-M01', '2025-10-01'

last_periods.description: Number of most recent periods (weeks/months/years) to return

region.description: CHFL, CH, FL, a canton code (ZH, BE, …) or a wastewater plant name

value_category.description: Measure, e.g. 'cases', 'consultations', 'detections', or a virus for wastewater ('influenza_a', 'sars-cov-2'); defaults to the main one

name: get_disease_surveillance
title: Infectious disease cases & incidence
